status: prospective execution plan; no Cooja study outputs available at creation
source: synthetic deterministic blocks of 250 signed 16-bit samples
primary_contrast: adaptive versus shuffled identical per-round offered payload multiset
primary_outcome: fixed-horizon receiver RMSE with zero reconstruction for unavailable or late reports
secondary_outcomes: mean delivered hop count from source hop limit and received IPv6 TTL
warmup: 10 report rounds, full 16-bit depth for every policy; excluded from primary utility
inference: One original primary RMSE contrast remains adaptive vs shuffled. Secondary seed-level effects and routing interaction plus RD-vs-own-shuffle; Holm across all secondary contrasts within each case. Exploration labelled; no cross-case significance claim.
claim_boundary: Cooja native network simulation, not hardware timing or calibrated total-device energy; rank hook uses an advertised radio-reserve proxy
revision_timing: Revised before the first Cooja study execution; no study outcomes inspected
routing_factorial: Replay identical adaptive and shuffled per-source per-round offered schedules under standard ETX and residual-radio-reserve MRHOF; secondary paired difference-in-differences

rd_baseline.decision: argmin local actual codec MSE + price * data_bytes / 250
rd_baseline.claims: causal conventional baseline; no new optimality theorem or hard budget guarantee
